definitions.explanation: A place to put one's foot when climbing or a secure position from which to advance.
Something that helps one make progress or achieve a goal figuratively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足掛|あしが}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: To look for a foothold on the rock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{足掛|あしが}かり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need footholds to climb the cliff.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{足掛|あしが}かり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦キャリアアップ→キャリアアップ：07818_kyariaappu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I aim to advance my career using this qualification as a stepping stone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{足掛|あしが}かり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、さらに⟦{飛躍|ひやく}→飛躍：08637_hiyaku⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to use this success as a springboard to achieve even more.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターンシップ→インターンシップ：24119_intaanshippu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足掛|あしが}かり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Internships serve as a stepping stone to employment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足掛|あしが}かり⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}した→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: As a foothold for overseas expansion, we first established a local subsidiary.

notes:
{足掛|あしが}かり has a literal meaning (a physical foothold for climbing) and a figurative meaning (a stepping stone or springboard for advancement). The figurative use is much more common.

WRITING:
Also written as {足がかり} (mixed) or {足懸|あしが}かり.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {足掛|あしが}かり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a stepping stone
- {足掛|あしが}かり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use as a stepping stone
- {足掛|あしが}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to gain a foothold
- {足掛|あしが}かり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧: to establish a foothold

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{手掛|てが}かり→手掛かり：06871_tegakari⟧: handhold; clue (parallel formation with ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧)
- ⟦{足場|あしば}→足場：06518_ashiba⟧: scaffolding; footing (more physical/construction)
- ⟦{踏|ふ}み{台|だい}→踏み台：09327_fumidai⟧: stepping stool; also figurative springboard
